_comment: Copy this next to your EDL as brand.json and point the EDL's 'brand' field at it.
Any subset works: whatever you leave out falls back to a neutral default.
'font' and 'font_regular' are FILE PATHS, used by ffmpeg's drawtext for headlines.
'caption.font_family' is an INSTALLED FAMILY NAME, used by libass for captions.
libass resolves fonts by family, not by file, so getting that one wrong makes
captions quietly fall back to a default face.
Check a family name: fc-list : family | sort -u | grep -i brandname
Size ratios are fractions of the canvas HEIGHT, so one brand file gives
sensible type on a 9:16 phone cut and a 16:9 web cut alike.
Colours accept '#RRGGBB', a colour name, or 'name@opacity' such as 'black@0.55'.
